```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# =====================================================================================================
# Spatial distribution of cod catches
# 
# 22/12/2024 first coding
#
# =====================================================================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,	message = FALSE,	warning = FALSE,	comment = "",	crop = TRUE )
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=10) 

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

# Reset lists
rm(list=ls())

# Libraries
library(rmarkdown)                   # note: requires knitr 1.21

require(tidyverse, quietly=TRUE)     # combined package of dplyr, tidyr, ggplot, readr, purrr and tibble
require(lubridate, quietly=TRUE)     # data handling
require(reshape2, quietly=TRUE)      # reshaping data; e.g. cast
require(RColorBrewer)                # colour schemes
library(viridis)
library(pander)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)                   # composer of plots

library(captioner)                   # for captions
tab_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = "Table " , levels=1, type=c("n"), infix=".")
fig_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = "Figure ", levels=1, type=c("n"), infix=".")

# Source all the utils
source("../../flyshoot/R/FLYSHOOT utils.r")

datadir   <- "C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/WQ - General/2025/data"
rdatadir   <- "C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/WQ - General/2025/rdata"
spatialdir <- "C:/DATA/RDATA"
gisdir     <- "C:/DATA/GIS"

rect_lr_sf  <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "rect_lr_sf.RData")) %>% rename(rect=ICESNAME)
world_mr_sf <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "world_mr_sf.RData")) %>% sf::st_as_sf()
eez_sf      <- 
  loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "eez_sf.RData")) %>% 
  # sf::st_simplify(., preserveTopology = FALSE, dTolerance = 500) %>% 
  rename(country = ISO_SOV1) %>% 
  filter(country %in% c("DEU","DNK","GBR","NLD","BEL","FRA")) %>% 
  mutate(class="eez")

asfis       <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "asfis.RData"))

e1 <- loadRData("C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/FLYSHOOT - General/rdata/elog.RData") 

filelist <- list.files(
  path=file.path(datadir),
  pattern="kabeljauw",
  recursive=TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE)

if(!is_empty(filelist)){
  
  m <- data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  i <- 1
  for (i in 1:length(filelist)) {
    
    m  <-
      bind_rows(
        m,
        readxl::read_excel(filelist[i], 
                           sheet = "landed catch details table",
                           col_names=TRUE, col_types="text",
                           .name_repair =  ~make.names(., unique = TRUE))  %>% 
          data.frame() %>% 
          lowcase() %>% 
          rename(
            rect = icesrectangle,
            vessel = vesselhullnumber,
            division = faozone,
            gear = geartype,
            # landings = catchweight,
            weight = catchweight,
            catchdate = activitydate,
            economiczone = economicalzone,
            species = fishspecie
          ) %>% 
          
          {if(any(grepl("latitide",names(.)))) {rename(., lat = latitide)} else{.}} %>% 
          {if(any(grepl("latitude",names(.)))) {rename(., lat = latitude)} else{.}} %>% 
          {if(any(grepl("longitude",names(.)))) {rename(., lon = longitude)} else{.}} %>% 
          {if(any(grepl("haulid",names(.)))) {rename(., haul = haulid)} else{.}} %>% 
          
          mutate(across (any_of(c("boxes", "meshsize", "haul")),
                         as.integer)) %>%
          mutate(across (any_of(c("catchdate", "departuredate","arrivaldate", "auctiondate", 
                                  "landingdate", "weight", "lat", "lon", "conversionfactor")),
                         as.numeric)) %>%
          mutate(across (any_of(c("catchdate", "departuredate","arrivaldate", "auctiondate",
                                  "landingdate")), 
                         ~excel_timezone_to_utc(., timezone="Europe/Amsterdam"))) %>% 
          
          mutate(date   = as.Date(catchdate)) %>% 
          mutate(economiczone = ifelse(economiczone == "GBR", economiczone, "XEU")) %>% 
          {if(any(grepl("haul",names(.)))) {mutate(., haul = haul - min(haul, na.rm=TRUE)+1)} else{.}} %>% 
          
          mutate(vessel = gsub("-","", vessel)) %>% 
          mutate(vessel = gsub("\\.","", vessel)) %>% 
          
          mutate(
            year       = lubridate::year(date),
            quarter    = lubridate::quarter(date),
            month      = lubridate::month(date),
            week       = lubridate::week(date),
            yday       = lubridate::yday(date))
        
        # left_join(rect_df, by="rect") %>% 
        # mutate(
        #   lat = lat + 0.25,
        #   lon = lon + 0.5
        # ) %>% 
        
      )
    
  } # end of pefa elog for loop
  
} # end of not empty filelist

# janitor::compare_df_cols(e1, m) %>% View()

e <-
  bind_rows(e1, m) %>% 
  left_join(rect_lr_sf, by="rect") %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# calculate the scaling of plots
bb <- sf::st_bbox(e)
xmin <- bb[1]
xmax <- bb[3] ;
ymin <- bb[2]
ymax <- bb[4]
xlim <- c(xmin, xmax); ylim <- c(ymin, ymax)

# s %>% filter(species == "COD") %>% View()
```

\newpage

Overview of cod landings per rect and per month  

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=1.0, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

fig_nums(
  name    = "map1", 
  level = 1, display = FALSE,
  caption = "Landings (kg) of participating vessels in 'open' parts of the EEZs (black), MPAs (red) and offshore wind areas (blue). ")

e %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year == 2024) %>% 
  group_by(species, year, month, rect) %>% 
  summarise(
    weight = sum(weight, na.rm=TRUE),
    ndays  = n_distinct(vessel, date)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(weightperday = weight / ndays) %>% 
  # mutate(., weightperday_interval = cut(weightperday, 
  #           scales::trans_breaks("sqrt", function(x) x ^ 2)(c(0, max(weightperday, na.rm=TRUE))), 
  #                                dig.lab=10 ) ) %>% 
  mutate(., weightperday_interval = cut(weightperday, 
            breaks=c(0,20,50,100,1000,10000), 
                                 dig.lab=10 ) ) %>% 

  sf::st_as_sf() %>% 
  
  # filter(is.na(weightperday_interval)) %>% View()

  
  ggplot() +
  theme_publication() +
  # theme(legend.position = "none") +
  
  geom_sf(data=rect_lr_sf, fill=NA) +
  geom_sf(data=world_mr_sf) +
  geom_sf(data=eez_sf, linetype="dashed", fill=NA) +
  
  # catches
  geom_sf(aes(fill=weightperday_interval), alpha=0.8) +
  
  coord_sf(xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)  +
  labs(fill="weight/day/vessel (kg)", title="Cod landings 2024 per day and per vessel of selected vessels") +
  facet_wrap(~month, ncol=4)


```

_`r fig_nums("map1")`_
